name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Email Marketing & Lifecycle Campaigns | Build, Segment, QA, Deploy & Measure
summary: Email and lifecycle marketer who takes campaigns from brief to deployment: writing the copy, building the sequence, setting audiences and personalization, checking every link and trigger before launch, and reporting on what worked. Hands-on in HubSpot, Marketo, Mailchimp, and GoHighLevel, with 20+ automated lifecycle workflows built and deployed. Launched e-commerce storefronts for established retail businesses at Wix, and a Colorado local who camps and hikes.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Built and deployed 20+ automated lifecycle workflows in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, including onboarding nurture, reminders, win-back and reactivation, and review-generation sequences.
Built segmented email campaigns by audience trigger (website visibility, missed calls, low reviews), with personalization driven by each contact's data.
Write direct-response copy, email sequences, and landing pages, and build reusable templates adapted to each client's brand.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Produced complex email sequences, landing pages, and conversion-focused copy that improved lead generation.
Built campaign reporting on ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion, ran A/B-tested campaigns, and delivered recommendations in QBRs.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Built automated product-training sequences and communication workflows for a 15-20 partner network, retaining all but one (~94%).

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Analyzed campaign performance at a performance marketing agency and translated results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Built and launched e-commerce sites for established retail businesses adding online sales to their physical stores.
Contributed to a 30% increase in website traffic and a 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
